purpose: Execution status for the four bounded high-yield tasks selected after the global archive sweep. This is a research status file, not a public progress counter.

targets.target: St Andrews — Charles Elcock letters, 6–8 March 1884
targets.result: Exact archive locator closed at ms21974-ms21975. The catalogue explicitly states that the correspondence refers to Challenger expedition samples. The decisive Challenger passage itself is not transcribed in the indexed record, so sender/sample/station/purpose remain open until page images are obtained.
targets.grade: S archive locator; A+/S-candidate content bridge
targets.next_bounded_action: Obtain/transcribe ms21974-ms21975 only; no broad St Andrews search needed.

targets.result: Diagnostic preparation-level harvest completed from official resource documentation and the published collection study: M/subnumber addressing, 105-drawer slide cabinet, multiple preparation forms, Haeckel annotation, Norman preparation, Voigt/Hochgesang preparations, and the 127-preparation 1920 return event are now structured. Full 4,723-row spreadsheet harvest was not possible in this runtime because the binary resource was not retrieved.
targets.grade: S address architecture; A+/S diagnostic objects; full-table harvest open
targets.next_bounded_action: When the resource binary is available, ingest all rows and subset preparation/slide terms plus named preparators without early exit.

targets.result: Systematic plate-caption pass across Memorial Edition volume I completed at designation level. Secure surviving-set/publication matches now include aa, a, A, B, C/c and E. The previous first-pass negative for E is superseded. Historical captions also use CC, D, DD, F and immersion/numbered optics that are not silently mapped to current surviving lenses.
targets.grade: S designation/publication layer; exact physical lens-to-figure identity open
targets.next_bounded_action: Search Zeiss serial/dispatch records for 573, 1295, 710, 780 and 542, then query surviving Balfour section series by figure taxon/stage.

targets.target: Naples catalogue row 383 ↔ St Andrews Delphinus phocaena BPM/1/T8/6
targets.result: Official object record and BHL catalogue container reverified. 'Panis 383' remains exact St Andrews transcription and 383 remains structurally inside the derived Mammalia range 373–405. The individual historical row/image was not recovered in this pass, so catalogue-number identity remains unclosed.
targets.grade: A candidate only for 383; no S-level object-row closure
targets.next_bounded_action: Retrieve BHL/IA page containing rows 382–384 and compare verbatim wording before any further Naples expansion.

net_result: One task produced a substantial S-level publication/instrument closure (Balfour), one produced an S-level address architecture plus diagnostic object harvest (Challenger), one narrowed an archival bridge to two exact letters (Elcock), and one remained deliberately unresolved after a failed page-level retrieval test (Naples).
methodological_note: A failed bounded verification is retained as a result when it prevents a false object identity. Do not promote catalogue-number, station, or instrument-object identity from structural plausibility alone.
